new_issues.description: The 'settled' criterion (no move above 1e-4) uses an absolute tolerance that is not rescaled with the cube. §4.1 says Euclidean dynamics are unchanged by shifting and rescaling, so its unit and centred cells are the same 9 designs; yet the Euclidean unsettled shares and convergence times differ between paired unit/centred cells (d=2, c=5%: 66%/31% vs 60%/22%; d=2, c=30%: 523 vs 468 rounds; d=4, c=5%: 92%/67% vs 91%/55%). The per-cell settled table, the pooled 26%/13%/14% and the convergence-time gap therefore depend on the coordinate coding, an instance of the hidden choice the paper warns about.

post_letter_observations: Letter (What changed) says bootstrap intervals are now order-independent and 'rebuilding twice gives identical numbers'; the manuscript does not describe the bootstrap seeding, so this is not checkable from the manuscript (claim about code). Consistent with it: only CI endpoints (e.g. \VXCosCosVar, \VXEucCosVar) and \VRunPassEquiv (34->32) changed among macros not tied to the relative-effect switch; case interaction CIs (e.g. \VCDraftCI) are unchanged, which a per-interval reseed would normally alter; worth one line of explanation.

R13: the letter repeats the manuscript's 'margin fixed before the analysis' for \VInterMargin. It matches §5.2's wording, but the round-2 manuscript had already reported the own-target interval this margin tests (2A residual); the wording should say so.

NEW-1: the letter says cosine's lag-0 effect is 'less than half Euclidean's'; §5.1 says 'about half' in general (recommended cell -0.060/-0.119 = 0.50); 'less than half' holds for the own-target cell (§5.3). Wording only, not counted as an overstatement.
R1: the letter does not mention the uncited 'which is how most BC studies start' (§3), still present; the residual stays open.
R14: the letter does not address the 2A finding that 'a modest change makes a large ratio' contradicts the extreme cell's own numbers (lag-40 effect about -0.123 against lag-0 -0.042).

R12/R10/R3: the letter is silent on the frozen 2A new issues NEW-4 (settled tolerance not coordinate-invariant), NEW-7 (early-matched calibration error unreported), NEW-8 (case CI method dropped 'bootstrap'), NEW-5, NEW-6 and NEW-9; expected, since they were raised after the letter was written.

The letter's closing ('the checked anchors above are the record of what the manuscript now contains') is true for anchor existence (script-checked) but not for status: 11 claims overstate what the manuscript shows (letter_overstatements).

External check: Gilbert et al. 2018, JASSS 21(1) 14, doi 10.18564/jasss.3669 (https://www.jasss.org/21/1/14.html) and Windrum, Fagiolo & Moneta 2007, JASSS 10(2) 8 (https://www.jasss.org/10/2/8.html) match refs.bib.
